evidence_scheme: Each claim not proved on the page carries one class: empirical result (paper and page), engineering check (this chapter's code or shown arithmetic), product claim, speaker judgment (with recording time). Definitions and results proved on the page carry no label. Each section opens with a provenance line: lecture / research extension / original construction.
running_case: Dining-hall face verification. Photo x in R^16 = face block (4 coords) mu_j + x_w, mu_j ~ N(0, Var_b I), x_w ~ N(0, Var_w I), Var_b = 1, Var_w = 0.09; lighting block (6) and scene block (6) ~ N(0, I), all redrawn per photo. Linear encoder f(x) = Wx/||Wx||, W in R^{4x16}. Trigger-word thread (slide 17 labels) developed second and handed to chapter 6.
